annotations.title: Call a flayr tool by name

description: Runs any flayr tool, listed or not, with the same scopes, plan checks and confirmations as calling it directly. The inner tool's own risk applies: confirm PUBLISHES or DESTRUCTIVE tools with the user first.

arguments.description: The tool's arguments as an object, e.g. {"brandId": "b_123"}. Omit for none.

name.description: The tool name from search_tools or enable_toolset, e.g. "ads_campaigns_list".

name: call_tool
title: Call a flayr tool by name
